image_description: A close-up portrait of a Brown Pelican (Pelecanus occidentalis) facing forward against a plain, light blue-grey background. The bird features dark brown plumage on its neck and body, with a pale yellow/cream-colored head and crown. Its most prominent feature is a long, massive bill with a visible gular pouch structure at the base, colored in shades of grey and pale orange. The eye is dark and distinct. The image focuses on the head and upper torso, cropping out the legs, feet, and full wing span.
